limitations: Reviewed means scoped arithmetic/provenance checks and known-anomaly exclusions, not official certification.
All raw scoped rows are retained; withheld rows never enter reviewed county or state aggregates.
State sums contain only reviewed counties, not guaranteed complete statewide or district totals.
Native auxiliary gaps/no-ballot records are metadata, never invented zero-vote candidates. Their documented overlay methods do not approve historical map joins.
The compiler excluded Maine's 2016 federal/UOCAVA 23099 and 2020 23000 buckets from its county release. Do not allocate those buckets into counties or call the reviewed-county state sum complete.
Party/candidate labels are the compiler's literals, not independently verified original ballot labels.
The compiler fills some originally blank parties from other labeled rows for the same state/district/candidate; preserve compiler literals, not a claim of independent ballot identity review.
The older GA/KY 2016 blank-party warnings are superseded by the compiler's later fixed entry. Native Other/write-in labels and the explicit zero-vote Other line for John A. Yarmuth remain unchanged.
Missouri 2016 Clay, Jackson and Platte vectors are withheld because the compiler excludes 127,894 Kansas City votes in a noncounty bucket. Never apportion those votes by guesswork.
Kentucky/Florida 2016 have documented small clean-rebuild residual differences; reviewed means arithmetic against this pinned release, not independent certified-count verification.
Preserve surname_only/initials_only flags; no identities or zeros are invented.
Compiler 2024 Oregon major-party overrides use secondary Wikipedia facts; code and attribution retained.
Generated candidate_name_overrides.csv is not in the pinned repository; no complete name audit is claimed.
The pinned QA CSV has 53 records, while correction-log prose says 64; Yazoo 2022 is separately withheld.
NJ 2022 and 2024 are already official-source replacements, outside this MEDSL-only scope. The old NJ 2022 MEDSL duplication warning is not a defect in the current official-source rows.

Maine, Indiana, New York and Texas House 2018 are official-source replacements outside this scope. Superseded MEDSL warnings and Senate-only anomalies do not invalidate those current House replacements.
Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, North Carolina, New York, Texas and Virginia House 2016 are outside this MEDSL-only scope; Florida and Kentucky also have separate official-source county vectors.
Native Montana 2022 believed_cc0 remains unchanged; the 2022 House DOI independently declares CC0.
No new county maps, historical boundary crosswalks, turnout or demographic participation estimates.
